    def input():
        return sys.stdin.read().strip()

    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    a = list(map(int, data[2:]))

    a.sort(reverse=True)
    current_time = 0
    disk_usage = 0
    download_heap = []

    for size in a:
        if disk_usage + size > m:
            while disk_usage + size > m:
                next_video_end_time, next_video_size = heapq.heappop(download_heap)
                current_time = max(current_time, next_video_end_time)
                disk_usage -= next_video_size
        current_time += 1
        disk_usage += size
        heapq.heappush(download_heap, (current_time + size, size))

    last_video_end_time, _ = heapq.heappop(download_heap)
    print(last_video_end_time)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
